source_supports: ABS BLADE pages support that BLADE combines tax, ABS survey, trade, IP, ASIC, DEWR, and other administrative sources for active businesses and business performance/productivity analysis.
not_found_or_not_proven: Public ABS pages do not provide full code labels for all generated BLADE variables; use `inst/blade_metadata/variables.csv` as the local DIL-style schema source.

source_supports: Local BLADE metadata and generated tests support the key products and identifier-link fields used by the package.

product_area: BAS, PAYG, BIT, STP, EEH, and survey-style tables
source_supports: ABS BLADE pages identify major data themes and source agencies; local metadata identifies generated table/variable names and valid-response notes where populated.
not_found_or_not_proven: Public source-agency pages still need to be attached before generated financial, payroll, and survey fields are interpreted beyond local schema/valid-response metadata.

source_supports: Local smoke output and tests support implementation ranges and consistency checks.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find official source-data distributions for the generated BLADE financial/payroll amounts or flags.

product_area: Census variable definitions and code labels
source_supports: The ABS 2021 Census Dictionary is the official source for variable definition, scope, categories, derivation, form questions, history, and data-use considerations. It should override local generator constants whenever a column uses an ABS mnemonic. The Census code-evidence register now attaches ABS Dictionary URLs for generated mnemonics where a public page exists.
not_found_or_not_proven: The rebuild still needs frozen machine-readable code tables for large classifications and any future dictionary-accuracy tests that go beyond URL-level evidence.

source_supports: The ABS supplementary-codes paper supports the use of symbol codes such as `&`, `@`, and `V` and explains that code width varies by variable.
not_found_or_not_proven: PLIDA-specific geography fields such as `STEUCP` and `STEUCD` still need DIL/ASGS verification because they are not exposed as ordinary public Census Dictionary pages in the same way as standard Census mnemonics.

source_supports: Local foundation files and current generator output support implementation checks only.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find an official source that validates the current generated category frequencies or foundation distribution weights.

source_supports: ABS PLIDA and Life Course Dataset sources support the broad idea of an integrated person spine and core demographic/vital concepts drawn from linked administrative sources.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public variable-level codebook for generated `CORE_GENDER`, `BIRTH_CTRY_CODE`, or source-specific death-date component coding.

source_supports: ABS Life Course sources support annual address/location concepts, common-address household construction, geocoded locations, and the development of Core Locations modules in PLIDA.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find public code labels for generated `ADR_TYP`, `SOURCE_FLAG`, or the exact local DIL `STATE`/ASGS coding conventions used by the compact generator.

source_supports: ABS data-development pages support the existence of Core Relationships modules for parent-child and spouse relationships where possible.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find public labels for generated `COMBINED_CATEGORY`, `COMBINED_STATUS`, or relationship source-marker values.

source_supports: Local generator and PLIDA metadata support the derived ever-Aboriginal, ever-TSI, and ever-Indigenous columns by name.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public ABS codebook that documents the exact current synthetic derivation inputs or real PLIDA combined-Indigenous construction rule.

source_supports: MBS Online and the classification specifications are official anchors for schedule items and classification fields such as category, group, subgroup, and subheading.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find an official source for the generated claim-amount distributions; the amount quantiles remain smoke-output evidence.

source_supports: The PBS API data dictionary is the official anchor for PBS item, prescribing-rule, co-payment, restriction, ATC, prescriber, organisation, and related concepts. The PBS fees page supports the current `$25.00` general and `$7.70` concessional co-payment thresholds.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find an official source for the generated benefit/contribution amount distributions or all compact prescriber/pharmacy/under-copayment flag labels.

source_supports: Health guidance establishes AIR reporting context and points to reporting-rule data elements.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public AIR code table for every generated compact antigen, episode-status, and schedule-classification value.

source_supports: AIHW NACDC sources and the May 2026 table specifications support aged-care concepts and expose source data-item names, types, and value lists for sex, Indigenous status, country of birth, marital status, state, care approvals, and functional-capacity fields.
not_found_or_not_proven: Generated `COUNTRY_OF_BIRTH`, `INDIGENOUS_STATUS`, `MARITAL_STATUS`, `CARE_TYPE`, and `HCP_LEVEL` are compact local representations rather than source-equivalent public NACDC code values; `STATE` needs its crosswalk tightened to an ASGS `STE_CODE`-style field rather than `RECIPIENT_STATE`.

source_supports: Services Australia statistics pages are context sources for Medicare administrative statistics.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public MCD variable-level codebook for generated consumer-status and program-code labels.

source_supports: DSS metadata pages and the Aristotle DOMINO entry support the use of DOMINO as longitudinal social-security administrative data and warn PLIDA users to rely on the PLIDA version.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find public variable-level Aristotle pages for every generated benefit, component, end-reason, medical, housing, and education code used by the local generator. See `dss-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: DEX policy and protocol documents are official anchors for service/session reporting, extended data, SCORE, and outcome framing.
not_found_or_not_proven: Generated assistance, exit-reason, demographic, and SCORE fields still need exact protocol-table-to-variable mapping before labels are treated as official. See `dss-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: The Department of Education student-data page is an official anchor for student, enrolment, completion, and HELP-style higher-education statistics and variable context.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find exact public code-label tables for every local numeric HE category used in the generated tables; only attendance type/mode have exact TCSI anchors in this pass. See `education-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: Education/AEDC pages and the AEDC data dictionary support the five-domain structure and provide the right official source for AEDC variable definitions.
not_found_or_not_proven: The generated 0-10 domain-score distributions and `Vulnerable`/`At risk`/`On track` cutoffs remain local generator logic until mapped to AEDC dictionary/scoring rules. See `education-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: Home Affairs settlement reporting pages and the SDB data dictionary are the official anchors for settlement-record scope and SDB field/code interpretation.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public source in this pass that proves the generated SDB category distributions or maps every generated Home Affairs compact value to an official code label. See `home-affairs-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: The AMEP profile paper is useful program context, and local PLIDA metadata contains ASLPR and hours concepts.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public AMEP variable-level codebook or score-distribution source for the generated ASLPR/hours fields. See `home-affairs-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: Local PLIDA metadata provides variable names and current generated schemas.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public Home Affairs codebook for generated visa subclass/reporting-group values or the generated traveller `1`/`2`/`3` quarterly status encoding. See `home-affairs-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: NDIS public dataset pages support participant, support budget, utilisation, diagnosis, plan-management, goal, First Nations, and CALD concepts.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public source that proves the generated support-category, disability-group, participant-status, or plan-budget distributions. See `ndis-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: NDIS management-options guidance supports the existence of self-managed, plan-managed, and NDIA-managed funding concepts.
not_found_or_not_proven: The generated `MANAGEMENT_TYPE` labels still need an exact DIL/public dataset variable mapping before being treated as official code labels. See `ndis-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: ATO payment-summary and withholding sources support payment-summary concepts such as gross payments, tax withheld, reportable fringe benefits, reportable employer superannuation contributions, and lump sums. Local DIL metadata provides same-dataset crosswalks for ten compact generated PIT_PS fields.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find same-dataset PIT_PS metadata support for generated `UNION_FEES` or `WORKPLACE_GIVING`; they remain external-source concepts, not source-equivalent PIT_PS variables.

source_supports: ATO myTax and tax-return sources support the broad income, deduction, offset, Medicare levy, and taxable-income concepts in the compact ITR generator.
not_found_or_not_proven: The guide still needs exact local DIL-to-tax-return item citations for every simplified tax calculation component before it can be treated as a complete ATO tax calculator.

source_supports: ABS administrative-income sources support the role of PS and ITR in derived administrative income estimates.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public source that validates the current generated edited-income noise model or all component distributions.

not_found_or_not_proven: Generated `SUPER_GUARANTEE` remains local SG-style logic and is not source-equivalent to `PIT_PS/RPRTBL_EMPLYR_SUPER_CNTRBN_AMT`.

source_supports: Local PLIDA metadata proves the generated STP variable names and product/table names used in this package. The representative generated schema has direct metadata matches for all 92 observed STP rows.
not_found_or_not_proven: Public ATO pages do not prove the local DIL column names one-for-one; use local DIL metadata for exact schema and ATO pages for reporting semantics.

source_supports: ATO STP reporting rules support reporting period gross salary/wages and PAYG withholding through pay events.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find public evidence that `INCM_GRS_AMT` and `PMT_SUMRY_TOTL_GRS_PMT_AMT` should always be equal; their equality is current local generator behaviour only.

source_supports: ATO Phase 2 guidance supports the distinction that Phase 2 disaggregates gross into more separately itemised components.
not_found_or_not_proven: The current local STP product should not be described as observing Phase 2 bonus, overtime, paid-leave, salary-sacrifice, or hours variables unless those DIL fields are actually present.

source_supports: ABS AWE/EEH/Characteristics of Employment methodologies support the warning that survey earnings concepts differ from raw STP pay-event fields.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a source that makes STP pay-event gross equivalent to AWOTE, OTE, hourly wages, or full-time adult ordinary-time earnings.

source_supports: NCVER collection pages and AVETMISS data-element definitions are the official anchors for TVA element definitions and many VET code-list checks.

source_supports: DEWR pages support program context, and local metadata gives same-dataset A&T concept matches for compact generated fields.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find a public A&T variable-level codebook in this pass for generated status weights, qualification-level weights, or all compact category labels. See `vet-apprentice-variable-code-evidence.csv` for row-level status.

source_supports: ABS Births methodology supports scope, registration source, registration timing caveats, and the role of state and territory Registrars of Births, Deaths and Marriages.
not_found_or_not_proven: I did not find exact ABS/AIHW source tables in this pass for generated birthweight, multiple-birth-rate, maternal-age, or paternity distribution targets.
